title: Minimum Average Difference
summary: Given an integer array nums, find the index where the absolute difference between the average of the first i+1 elements and the average of the remaining elements is minimized.
statement: Given an integer array nums, find the index where the absolute difference between the average of the first i+1 elements and the average of the remaining elements is minimized. Round down both averages. Return the smallest index if there are ties.
constraints: For index i, floor the average of nums[0:i+1] and the average of nums[i+1:n].
The average of the empty suffix at the last index is zero.
Minimize the absolute difference and return the smallest index on ties.
reference_solution:
def minimum_average_difference_index(nums):
    total=sum(nums);prefix=0;best=float('inf');answer=0
    for index,value in enumerate(nums):
        prefix+=value
        left=prefix//(index+1);right=(total-prefix)//(len(nums)-index-1) if index+1<len(nums) else 0
        difference=abs(left-right)
        if difference<best:best=difference;answer=index
    return answer
